observations: Role 97 defines strategic encounter scheduling, independent deterministic roll streams, awareness, raw score and count inputs, sustainable travel speed, selection and extensive source tests. The current encounter helper was separately inspected in bounded ranges in ASSESSMENT-L1-ENCOUNTER-SCORES.json; historical identity does not itself establish current or checkpoint 3821 behavior.

Role 101 describes wearable coverage, resistance, padding, flexibility and range-of-motion floats, a layer fold, and an ordering tie-breaker. Raw fields and their producer admissions remain connected to the armor and aggregate-state reviews; this alone does not show a bad catalog or live armor failure.

Role 102 uses SignedLength in a historic parametric weapon geometry constructor with cross-field inequalities, while mass, inertia, balance and precision remain f32 and its fields are public. The current file has a different SHA-256; do not project this historic shape onto the current revision. It is related to, but does not complete, weapon-length and precision ledger tracing.

Role 103 derives melee preparation and recovery elapsed values from style, unarmed status and raw inertia, with a finite-value fallback; tests were read, not executed. Role 105 implements strategic daily fatigue and burden skill conditioning, separate from tactical combat impairment. Producers and connected behavior must be assessed before any claim of duplication or combat penalty.
